summary: Wrote a 7-phase plan covering both parts. Part A chooses a reserved slashless file_scope sentinel (__WHOLE_TREE__) harvested through the existing Files-to-modify pipeline, consumed by a new fifth admission dimension appended last in orchestrate-batch-admit.sh with its own whole_tree_claim defer_reason and a research/plan phase exemption. This rejects the research report's zero-code recommendation (declare agent-system/ and reuse file_scope_collision) on three verified grounds: the collision branch never reads $phase_group so it inherits no phase exemption, validate-state.sh Check 8 already flags exactly that coarse trailing-slash declaration, and a real wide path would loosen path_covered_by_scope()'s containment guard. Part B tightens the plan-cache write guard to require a real dispatch row and folds canonical_force_phases_json into the cache key. Phases are red-baseline-tests-then-fix per part, then producer convention, then docs, then redeploy plus full gate.

artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan in 4 waves (~7.75h) adding a whole-tree-claim admission dimension and fixing the plan-cache replay key.
